limitations: Static project and package manifest extraction; projects are not all restored or built.
Target frameworks are read from project and inherited Directory.Build.props declarations; conditional MSBuild properties may require per-project evaluation.
Activity identity enumeration covers source types using [Activity(...)] attributes; activities declared through other mechanisms are not inferred.
NPM package manifests are inventoried; transitive NPM and NuGet license obligations are not resolved.
GitHub open issue/PR inventory and publisher evidence are described in the readable migration ledger; open does not mean actively progressing.

resolved_artifact_incident.evidence: Maintainer QA comment reports public nupkg 3-param contract in MongoDb/Dapper 3.8.4, nuspec commit 154ba15fb4da85b4bebecfbe43639579cbda1d0d, and clean AddElsa consumers; the known-negative 3.8.1 + Core 3.8.4 fails as expected.
resolved_artifact_incident.lesson: Use immutable source/nupkg provenance plus clean-consumer tests as a release gate; do not treat the resolved 3.8.1 incident as an open defect.
